articles.headline: Oil price falls back to pre-Iran war levels
articles.summary: Signs that traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route is gradually resuming has helped to push the oil price down.
articles._summary: The price of oil has fallen to levels not seen since before the Iran war as traffic through the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route gradually resumes. Global benchmark Brent crude briefly fell below $72.48 (Â£55) a barrel, the price it was at the day before the US and Israel launched attacks on Iran on 28 February, before edging up to $73.23. Energy prices have been on a wild ride since Iran responded to the strikes by effectively closing the strait, a critical waterway for oil and gas shipments. The cost of crude has been moving sharply lower since the US and Iran signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on 17 June which set out a 60-day period for negotiations on Tehran's nuclear programme and other measures to end the war. However, Pratibha Thaker, regional director of Middle East and Africa at the Economist Intelligence Unit, said though oil prices have fallen back to pre-conflict levels, risks still remain.
articles._zh_headline: 油价回落至伊朗战争前水平
articles._zh_summary: 随着霍尔木兹海峡主要航线的交通逐渐恢复，石油价格已跌至伊朗战争前以来的最低水平。全球基准布伦特原油一度跌破每桶 72.48 美元（55 英镑），这是美国和以色列 2 月 28 日对伊朗发动袭击前一天的价格，随后小幅升至 73.23 美元。自从伊朗通过有效关闭海峡这一石油和天然气运输的重要水道来应对袭击以来，能源价格一直在疯狂上涨。自美国和伊朗于 6 月 17 日签署谅解备忘录 (MOU) 以来，原油成本一直大幅走低，该谅解备忘录规定为期 60 天的时间，就德黑兰的核计划和其他结束战争的措施进行谈判。不过，经济学人智库中东和非洲区域主任普拉蒂巴·塔克表示，尽管油价已回落至冲突前水平，但风险依然存在。

articles.headline: Trump asks Congress for billions for Iran war, after tension with Republicans
articles.summary: But the budget faces an uphill battle as the president spars with some members of his own party over the issue.
articles._summary: Congress has told Trump to stop Iran war - why does it matter? The White House has asked lawmakers to approve $87.6bn (Â£66.5bn), mostly for "urgent needs" connected with the US war on Iran, a day after Congress passed a resolution rebuking the military action. The bulk of the funding - $67bn - is for the US Department of Defence, the White House said. But the proposal faces an uphill battle in Congress. The Iran conflict is unpopular with voters ahead of the US midterm elections in November, though a ceasefire is currently in effect. US President Donald Trump has also found himself at odds with some members of his Republican Party over the issue of Iran, and is alleged to have ended up in an angry exchange with one senator on Wednesday. That senator, Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, was one of a handful of Republicans who defied the president on Tuesday by voting to pass a measure demanding that he halt the war or seek congressional approval before continuing military action.
articles._zh_headline: 在与共和党关系紧张后，特朗普要求国会为伊朗战争提供数十亿美元
articles._zh_summary: 国会告诉特朗普停止伊朗战争——为什么这很重要？在国会通过一项谴责军事行动的决议一天后，白宫已要求立法者批准 876 亿美元（665 亿英镑），主要用于与美国对伊朗战争有关的“紧急需求”。白宫表示，其中 670 亿美元的大部分资金将提供给美国国防部。但该提案在国会面临着一场艰苦的战斗。尽管停火目前已经生效，但在 11 月美国中期选举之前，伊朗冲突不受选民欢迎。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普还发现自己与共和党一些成员在伊朗问题上存在分歧，据称周三与一名参议员发生了愤怒的交锋。这位来自路易斯安那州的参议员比尔·卡西迪是周二公然反抗总统的少数共和党人之一，他们投票通过了一项措施，要求他停止战争或在继续采取军事行动之前寻求国会批准。

articles._zh_summary: 标准普尔 500 指数周三收盘小幅走低，因投资者在美光科技 (Micron Technology Inc.) 公布季度财报之前仍保持谨慎态度。尽管如此，Polymarket 交易员绝大多数押注基准指数将在周四开盘反弹。标准普尔 500 指数收盘下跌 0.10%，报 7,358.22 点。然而，6 月 25 日的 Polymarket 合约暗示该指数周四高开的可能性为 97%。

articles.author: Anusuya Lahiri
articles.headline: Why Is NVIDIA Stock Gaining Thursday?
articles.summary: NVIDIA stock rises in premarket as Micron's stellar earnings beat boosts investor optimism for AI infrastructure spending.
articles._summary: The broader market also supported sentiment, with S&P 500 futures gaining about 0.7% ahead of the opening bell. Micron reported adjusted third-quarter earnings of $25.11 per share on revenue of $41.46 billion, beating Wall Street expectations. The company also forecast fiscal fourth-quarter adjusted earnings of about $31 per share on revenue of roughly $50 billion. Although Micron’s update was company-specific, investors viewed it as a positive signal for the broader AI hardware ecosystem, including NVIDIA.
articles._zh_headline: 为什么 NVIDIA 股票周四上涨？
articles._zh_summary: 大盘也支撑了市场情绪，标准普尔 500 指数期货在开盘前上涨约 0.7%。美光公布第三季度调整后每股收益 25.11 美元，营收 414.6 亿美元，超出华尔街预期。该公司还预计第四财季调整后每股收益约为 31 美元，营收约为 500 亿美元。尽管美光的更新是针对公司特定的，但投资者认为这对包括 NVIDIA 在内的更广泛的人工智能硬件生态系统来说是一个积极信号。

articles.author: Stjepan Kalinic
articles.headline: Despite The Gold Crash, Miners Offer A Massive Hidden Discount
articles.summary: Gold prices plunge 29% from their peak as Fed rate hike fears trigger a massive correction. Is the bull market over? Read more.
articles._summary: Gold’s spectacular rally, which made it one of the best-performing assets in 2025, has been undergoing an equally dramatic correction. Prices have tumbled around 29% from January’s record high of around $5,600 an ounce to below $4,000. The most popular ETF benchmark, SPDR Gold Trust (NYSE: GLD ) , has gone deeply into the red, down 8.12% year-to-date. The main catalyst has been an inflationary energy shock from the U.S.-Iran war.
articles._zh_headline: 尽管金价崩盘，矿商仍提供巨额隐藏折扣
articles._zh_summary: 黄金的惊人上涨使其成为 2025 年表现最佳的资产之一，但它也一直在经历同样剧烈的调整。价格已从 1 月份每盎司 5,600 美元左右的历史高点下跌约 29%，跌至 4,000 美元以下。最受欢迎的 ETF 基准 SPDR Gold Trust（纽约证券交易所股票代码：GLD）已陷入严重亏损，今年迄今已下跌 8.12%。主要催化剂是美伊战争造成的通胀能源冲击。
